0.1: While #p2151005# does not have many physical injuries, she is extremely weak because of everything the Black Wings put her through. If you're so anxious to help, why not make her a more comfortable bed? I think it would help her. Interested?

yes.0: Of course you're interested. How could I even doubt you? Well, now, let's have you gather the materials we need. Would you mind heading over to #b#m310030100##k to hunt #r#o1150001#s#k? They drop #b#t4000599#s#k. I need #b30#k of them.

no.0: No? Well, you were the one who brought it up...

1.0: You've brought the #t4000599#s I requested. I'd heard that you were a rookie who had the potential to rock the Resistance for the better, and they were right. Thank you. Now I can build a more comfortable bed.

yes.0: #p2151005# has expressed her gratitude even in her unstable condition. She says she owes her life to you. Please train harder, for #p2151005#'s sake.

item.0: Oh? Have you not found #b30 #t4000599#s#k yet? Did you get lost on the way? You can find #r#o1150001#s#k when you follow #b#m310030100##k out of Edelstein.
